description: List SAP supplier invoices, e.g. of one supplier (invoicing_party) or by the supplier's own invoice number (supplier_reference). Read-only.

filter.description: optional extra OData $filter, ANDed (e.g. "CreationDate ge datetime'2026-01-01T00:00:00'")

invoicing_party.description: SAP supplier number of the invoicing party

skip.description: Number of entries to skip (for paging)

name: list_sap_supplier_invoices
